Subject: Quick follow-up from today's call — retention/deletion questions

Thanks for the call this morning, Marissa — helpful overview. Two quick items the security team asked me to capture and follow up on so we can move to procurement: 

1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether Redwood currently holds SOC 2 Type II? If not, expected completion timeframe and whether Redwood will provide a readiness/attestation timeline for procurement.

2) Data retention / deletion: primary question from our privacy team is around customer-initiated deletion requests. What is Redwood's SLA for deletion of customer data (primary model inputs/outputs, user profiles) after a deletion request?

3) Logs and backups: what are default retention windows for request logs / audit trails and for backups/snapshots? If we request a shorter retention window for logs or a specific deletion SLA for backups, how does that work operationally?

4) HIPAA / GDPR: Amaya is evaluating for PHI handling and EU customers. Do you provide a BAA? What support for Data Subject Requests (DSRs) and cross-border data flows?

Also attaching the vendor questionnaire we'd like you to start filling out — it's the standard AMAYA security vendor questionnaire (we can accept a partial response + timeline). Can you point me to the person on your side who can complete that?

Thanks,

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>

Hi Jordan — thanks, and great talking earlier. Below are concise answers to your security/privacy questions; happy to jump on a short call if you'd like to walk through any item.

1) SOC 2: Redwood currently maintains SOC 2 Type II for our hosted inference service (controls relevant to availability, confidentiality, and security). We will provide the attestation under NDA/procurement. If you prefer, we can share a redacted report and SOC 2 cover letter via secure link.

2) BAA / HIPAA: We do offer a BAA for customers processing PHI. Execution of a BAA is handled via our legal team as part of the contract. For initial evaluation, we can provide our controls summary (attached) and a standard BAA template upon request.

3) GDPR / DSRs: We support Data Subject Requests. For customer-managed data we provide APIs and operational procedures to facilitate DSR fulfillment; for platform-level data we process requests on behalf of customers per contractual terms. For cross-border transfers, we rely on standard contractual clauses and offer regional hosting in the EU for EU-resident data.

4) Deletion SLA (customer data): Standard offering — primary customer data (uploads, model inputs/outputs, user profile data) will be removed from active storage within 72 hours of a validated deletion request and marked for permanent purge. Final irreversible deletion from backups and long-term archives may take up to 30 days depending on snapshot/backup retention windows; we can negotiate a shorter contractual SLA for deletion from backups for enterprise deals (RDW-terms).

5) Logs & audit trails: Default retention for request logs and audit trails is 90 days. These are stored in encrypted buckets and accessible via console/API. We can offer configurable retention windows (30/60/90 days) as part of Dedicated or Private deployments. Note: shortening log retention impacts forensic window; we'll document trade-offs in the questionnaire.

6) Backups / snapshots: Automated backups are encrypted at rest with customer-managed key options (KMS/HSM). Backup snapshots are retained for 90 days by default. Deletion of snapshots follows the snapshot lifecycle; immediate removal of a snapshot is possible but may be subject to the backup provider's snapshot deletion window (typically up to 7 days for final cleanup). For higher assurance we offer additional controls in Private deployments and can include contractual commitments in the SOW.

Next steps (proposed):
- We'll populate the vendor questionnaire with these responses and attach supporting docs (SOC 2 cover letter, controls summary, BAA template).
- If Amaya requires a tighter deletion SLA for backups (e.g., permanent purge within 7 days), please flag that in the questionnaire — we'll route to legal/infra for feasibility and incorporate into the deal terms (deal id RDW-2027-045).

If useful, I'm available Wed afternoon for a 30-min call with your security team.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
